verdict.rationale: Treasury docs name issuing as a financial account feature and describe Treasury plus Issuing as a combined embedded offering, so cards tied to the account are a first-party capability. Nothing in the pack details card issuance itself. The automatic fraud risk controls are not user-configurable spend controls, so they earn no credit. Missing for 10: explicit virtual and physical debit card issuance through the API, documented spend controls, digital wallet support, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, accounts come with cards — issue virtual and physical debit cards tied to the account through the same API, with spend controls and digital wallet support

citations.quote: Render Stripe financial account features such as bill pay, issuing, and cash rewards as a branded UI in your platform application
Launch Stripe Treasury and Issuing for platforms as a prebuilt set of embeddable components
